nodes.title: 提示词
widgets_values:
subject_definitions
- <Picture 1>: the target clothing reference. Use the complete outfit design: deep plum structured cropped jacket with a high asymmetric collar, sharp shoulders, long sleeves, copper-colored piping, brown leather wrap corset, long asymmetrical mauve skirt with a pleated panel, and matching dark plum ankle boots.
- <Video 1>: the source video. Preserve the original adult woman’s identity, face, facial features, body proportions, wet wavy hair, skin tone, expressions, poses, hand positions, walking performance, umbrella interaction, environment, rain, water splashes, lighting, camera motion, framing, timing, and original audio.
summary
video editing + reference generation. Replace only the woman’s original white dress and footwear in <Video 1> with the complete outfit from <Picture 1>. Keep the woman herself and every other element of the source video unchanged. The transferred outfit must remain temporally consistent and physically attached to her body throughout the entire shot.
retention_analysis
- fully_preserved: the woman’s face, identity, age, wet hairstyle, body shape, skin, expression, gaze, posture, hands, fingers, umbrella grip, walking rhythm, head movement, turning motion, source timing, camera path, framing, rainy wetland environment, transparent umbrella, falling rain, mist, vegetation, puddles, water splashes, teal cinematic lighting, depth of field, and embedded audio.
- attribute_transfer: transfer the entire clothing ensemble from <Picture 1>, including its deep plum and mauve color palette, structured cropped jacket, high asymmetric collar, copper piping, brown leather waist wrap, pleated and smooth asymmetric skirt panels, layered hem construction, and matching ankle boots.
- partially_preserved: preserve the original garment’s motion timing and body-driven deformation, but replace its appearance, silhouette, materials, color, seams, and construction with the outfit from <Picture 1>.
detailed_description
[Shot 1] Use <Video 1> as the exact motion, performance, camera, lighting, and scene reference for one continuous cinematic shot. Replace only the source woman’s white dress and footwear with the complete outfit shown in <Picture 1>. Do not replace or redesign her face, hair, body, hands, legs, or identity.
